_setup: Okta admin > Applications > Create App Integration > SAML 2.0. Single sign-on URL = the ACS URL and Audience URI = the Entity ID shown in CloudTerm Settings > Sign-in. Add a Group Attribute Statement named 'groups' (filter: starts with 'cloudterm-'). Copy the app's Metadata URL here.
label: Okta

_setup: Entra admin center > Enterprise applications > New application > Create your own > SAML. Identifier (Entity ID) and Reply URL (ACS) come from CloudTerm Settings > Sign-in. Under Attributes & Claims add a group claim (Security groups, emit as Group ID or sAMAccountName). Copy the App Federation Metadata Url here. If you emit group IDs, list the object IDs below.
label: Microsoft Entra ID

_setup: A federation metadata file (InCommon and friends) lists many IdPs, so entity_id names the one to trust; CloudTerm refuses such a file without it, rather than picking an arbitrary certificate. Single sign-on URL, Entity ID, and the SLO response endpoint come from CloudTerm Settings > Sign-in.
label: Shibboleth

_setup: Google Admin > Apps > Web and mobile apps > Add custom SAML app. ACS URL and Entity ID come from CloudTerm Settings > Sign-in; Name ID format EMAIL. Under Attribute mapping > Group membership, select the CloudTerm groups and set App attribute 'groups'. Download the IdP metadata XML and point metadata_file at it.
label: Google Workspace

_setup: Google over OIDC has no group claim, so it suits contractors who all get one role. Google Cloud console > APIs & Services > Credentials > OAuth client ID (Web). Authorized redirect URI = the Redirect URI shown in CloudTerm Settings > Sign-in. Keep the secret in an environment variable.
label: Google (contractors)

_setup: Entra over OIDC: App registrations > New registration, Web redirect URI from CloudTerm Settings > Sign-in. Token configuration > Add groups claim. Entra does not send email_verified, so it is turned off here; domains still restrict who can sign in.
label: Microsoft (OIDC)
